title: Valid Palindrome
statement: Return true when the string reads the same forwards and backwards, considering only letters and digits and ignoring case. Everything else is skipped.
hints: Two pointers, one from each end, walking toward each other.
Advance each pointer past anything that is not a letter or digit before comparing.
Compare case-insensitively. char.IsLetterOrDigit and char.ToLowerInvariant do the work.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
